ownerOutcome: Verify that the completed/repaired scenario survey can preserve enough behavior-only information to instantiate both the historical V1.1 merged HD+Western owner-recovery inputs and the clean V4.3/NetInformation behavioral inputs, then run each scoring family separately over its declared search procedure and compare which birth neighborhoods each recovers without target leakage.
nextAction: Collect only the narrow missing piece for F0 identified by fresh target-blind incremental coding. Preserve the existing F0 response as separate conditional evidence rather than force-fitting it. Then continue target-blind follow-up selection only if another repaired question can materially affect either scorer-family translation; otherwise freeze measurement v2 and recode.
runtimeBoundary: Raw answers and participant-specific coding remain private. Birth/chart/model/rank information must not be supplied to neutral follow-up selection/coding. Do not score the incomplete v1 profile and call a miss or hit a survey result.
surveyCompletionSemantics: The 68-answer pilot was completed, but it is not yet a complete v7-calibrated measurement because v7 replaced several pilot questions that were design-invalidated or construct-mismatched. Follow-ups are targeted replacement measurements, not an exhaustive-completeness requirement.

astroHDV43Status.freezeMeaning: Preserve the historical before/after audit and contamination status; do not prohibit future model improvement.
astroHDV43Status.futureRepairRule: Owner-informed AstroHD changes must be a new explicit post-ranking version/revision; the owner case is development data for that revision, not independent validation.
astroHDV43Status.comparisonWarning: V1.1 merged HD+Western and V4.3 HD/NetInformation-style are different scorers; V4.3 rank 1 is not better exact-time recovery.

dualScorerCalibration.measurementRule: Complete only material repaired neutral measurements; freeze one neutral profile before opening either target-aware crosswalk.
dualScorerCalibration.translationRule: From the same frozen neutral profile, derive and freeze V1.1 merged-cluster inputs and clean V4.3/NetInformation observable inputs separately before either birth search.
dualScorerCalibration.searchRule: Run each scorer with its own frozen scoring rules and declared search universe/procedure; do not force either scorer toward the known birth target.
dualScorerCalibration.comparisonRule: Report recovered dates/times/neighborhoods and ranks separately. Agreement is informative; disagreement diagnoses scorer/model differences rather than being silently averaged.
dualScorerCalibration.v43PrimaryComparison: Use the clean candidate-unexposed NetInformation variant as the primary V4.3 comparison. Candidate-exposed carrier refinements may be reported only as a separately labeled descriptive diagnostic.

stopAdmission.remainingGap: F0 has one unresolved neutral missing piece after its first replacement response; the dual-family neutral profile is not yet ready to freeze.
stopAdmission.nextAction: Owner answers the narrow F0 communication-comparison clarification; assistant then continues the already-authorized target-blind calibration automatically.
stopAdmission.responsibleActor: owner for the personal clarification response; assistant for preservation, coding, subsequent gap selection, freeze, translation, and scoring
stopAdmission.currentAuthority: dual-family owner recovery calibration authorized; raw participant answers and participant-specific coding remain private/outside Git
stopAdmission.executableBoundary: The requested distinction is participant-specific behavior and cannot be supplied by the assistant without fabricating evidence.
